correctness.rationale: A cut section vertex is exactly a vertex lying in the plane or one crossing intersection from an original edge. In C_n all distinct vertex pairs except antipodes are edges. With nonnegative offset b>0, r original vertices above, s on plane and 2n-r-s below, the crossing count is r(2n-r-s)−r plus s: v=s+r(2n-r-s−1). For b=0, r positive, r negative and 2(n-r) on the plane, crossing count r²−r, so w=r(r−1)+2(n−r). Explicit normals with coordinates 2,1,0 or 1,0 realize every indicated pair. Algebra bounds non-supporting sections below by 2n−2 and above by n(n−1). For vertex-avoiding cuts, every crossed signed-simplex j-face contributes one (j−2)-face and inclusion-exclusion on sign choices gives the polynomial. Generic r=1..n counts r(2n-r−1), last two coincide, the remainder strictly increase, giving exactly (n−2)² omissions in the integer range. Independently enumerated crossed edges and signed faces for every normal-sign type n=3..8; all exact identities agree. Geometric combinatorics, not the finite checks, proves general n.
residual_risks: Generic polynomial ONLY for hyperplanes avoiding all 2n original vertices; arbitrary degenerate-face spectra not classified, only vertex spectra.

value.rationale: The section-vertex spectrum and its sharp gaps are natural full classification questions for a central regular polytope family. A uniform all-dimensional answer, including degenerate support/central sections, complements the existing octahedral and general slice literature. The independent generic full-face polynomial is mathematically useful for enumerating all combinatorial face ranks, rather than a single unmotivated numeric slice.
residual_risks: Value applies to natural regular cross-polytope, not arbitrary perturbations or all nongeneric f-vectors.

final_claim: For C_n=conv(±e_i), n>=3, vertex counts of ALL nonempty hyperplane sections equal {s+r(2n-r-s-1):0<=r,s,1<=r+s<=n}∪{r(r-1)+2(n-r):1<=r<=n}; maximum n(n-1), supporting v<=n and interior v>=2n-2. If the hyperplane misses every C_n vertex, the complete section face polynomial is (1+2z)^n−(1+z)^r(1+2z)^(n−r)−(1+z)^r+1 for r positive originals, with n−1 distinct generic vertex counts and (n−2)^2 missing integers in their bounding interval.
